positive: Rapid design exploration or surprise direction without a full interview
A product needs varied-but-tasteful prototypes to compare before committing
A user says 'roll the dice', 'surprise me', or 'show me options'
negative: The user wants to commit to a specific direction by hand
A shipped public surface needs the full strict gate
The request is to improve an existing site rather than generate a new direction

exclusions: Do not roll outside the design rails or bypass the audit findings
Do not present a rolled design as a hand-interviewed committed direction
Do not skip the audit — findings are mandatory fixes regardless of seed
Do not skip the relaxed gate — random inputs still need contrast and readability checks

required: A numeric seed or instruction to derive one
optional: Chance MCP endpoint for multi-source entropy

outputs.primary: A seeded DESIGN-SYSTEM.md with resolved findings, rolled choices, and gate evidence

stop_conditions: Stop when the output will be a shipped public surface — escalate to tastecheck-pass strict gate
Stop if the user rejects the rolled direction and wants to answer the interview manually — hand off to design-system-interview
notes: Tasteroll is the proof-of-thesis skill: constraints produce taste even from random inputs. It separates deterministic mandatory fixes (audit findings) from seed-dependent aesthetic choices (rolled dimensions). The lock/reroll interaction model enables progressive commitment through rapid iteration.
